title: French 75 Jell-O Shots
description: These red and yellow Jell-O shots inspired by the French 75 cocktail are an easy make-ahead treat for your Game Day party.
ingredients: 0.5 (3 ounce) package lemon-flavored gelatin mix (such as Jell-O®)

steps.text: Pour boiling water over lemon-flavored gelatin in a glass measuring cup; stir to combine. Stir in gin. Pour mixture into sixteen 2-ounce cups. Arrange cups in muffin tins, tilted to one side.

Combine 1 1/4 cup sparkling wine and unflavored gelatin in a small pot. Let sit, about 3 minutes. Heat over low heat, stirring constantly, until gelatin is dissolved, 3 to 5 minutes. Add remaining 1/2 cup wine and food coloring; stir to combine.
Remove muffin tins from refrigerator. Set cups upright; pour wine mixture over lemon mixture.
Return to the refrigerator and chill until set, about 4 hours.

video.description: Make a toast to the new year or just living well with these diminutive shooters, sure to be a hit at your next party. Full of delicate botanical flavors from gin and bright with lemon and sparkling wine, these pretty little favors will look great on your table, too.
